An '''individual''' was the second [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Roan Shryne]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="DL" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19.5 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the Padawan was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Battle of Manari|Battle]] of [[Manari]]. The loss of his second student, combined with the demise of [[Roan Shryne's first Padawan|his first Padawan]] and [[Nat-Sem|his own master]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|earlier]] during the war, left Shryne disillusioned about the war and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] Master lost his hope in the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="DL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Padawan was mentioned in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'' written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="DL" />
